title: Close one joint erasing schedule uniformly over a parameter rectangle
statement: Use known rational nu0=ceil(nu_minus^-1)^-1,rho0=ceil(rho_minus^-1)^-1,mu0=min,coarse M0,tau0,epsilon0 and X<=CR. Set q=cstar X^-10,K0=Cstar(M0+1),a=ceil(Cstar K0/[gamma_star rho0 tau0 q]),g=gamma_star rho0 a^2,Gamma=Cstar(2+a+nu0^-1+rho0^-1)^dstar,T=min(tau0/100,1/[100Gamma],1/[100g]),J=100Gamma/T^2,r=q/[100Gamma J K0],r0=r/[100Gamma^2],Kstar=100Gamma K0,beta=min(1/1000,gT/[10^6 Gamma^8]). Choose rational h=min(T/1000,gT^2/[10^6Gamma^8],(r/[10^6Gamma^8 K0^2])^8,h_fixed,1/[Cstar a]); fixed caps pay corrected-reference pulse residual. Insert uniform reset <=beta h after each excursion. Exact return maps and fixed partial bounds keep envelopes independent of word compression/count. Accepted two-sided smoothing telescope gives ||U_(nu,rho)-exp(Tb Abar_(nu,rho))||H1->H1<=C Gamma^8(ell/Tb+beta),T/2<=Tb<=T, without fast time/parameter derivatives. Thus common contraction<=1-gTb/16, repeat nb=ceil(256K0/[qgTb]) and pay total time<=256K0/(qg)+T. Stirring local coupled bound <=Gamma r0+Gamma Kstar^2 h^.25<r/8; resets restore r0, including affine correction. Global induction Duhamel through H^(-3/4)->H1 smoothing closes sup||b||H1<=4K0+Gamma J(r sup||b||+eta_eff),using eta0=min(1,q/[100Gamma J],cstar mu0 q). This magnetic bootstrap pays Lorentz in velocity estimates. Initial reset lowers u while preserving magnetic bound; final reset plus contraction gives total pair H1<=q for ALL parameter pairs. Apply viscosity-independent fixed-depth lowering after nominal schedule, reserving finite coercivity/gap/reset/velocity/q margins with polynomial reciprocals; output then only twelve fields. No parameter sampling or multiplication of a fixed loss per reset.
